Python services accept any scopedJwtSecret-signed token as a full user token (token type confusion)

Signed download URLs are issued without binding to the requester and redeemed without an ACL check (cross-organization document access)
RCE: default SANDBOX_MODE=local runs agent-generated code inside the application pod, triggerable by any authenticated user

SSRF in url_fetcher: CGNAT/6to4 classifier gap + unvalidated redirect-follow reach internal/metadata services
